newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 rises, attention switches to refineries.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 rises, attention switches to refineries.

text.p: Czech share indices moved higher for the third straight session on Wednesday led by strong gains from major issues Komercni Banka and SPT Telecom.

The PX50 index rose 0.88 percent to 504.3 and the RPIX gained 1.34 percent 1,032.1. The RPIX index of continuously traded shares comprises 10 mainly highly capitalised issues which are also quoted on the PX50.
The biggest gainers among the high caps were SPT Telecom, which rose 40 crowns to 2,910 and Komercni Banka, which gained 56 crowns to 2,085.

Despite the gains from Komercni and SPT, attention moved towards Kaucuk and Chemopetrol after the boards of the shareholders comprising the main Czech refining company Unipetrol on Wednesday announced their plan for the conversion of Kaucuk and Chemopetrol shares into Unipetrol shares.

In a joint statement, the boards of Chemopetrol, Kaucuk and Unipetrol, said they agreed to swap one Chemopetrol share for between 1.05 to 1.20 Unipetrol shares, and one Kaucuk share for between 1.10 to 1.25 Unipetrol shares.

"I don't see any arbitrage opportunity at this moment," said Patria Finance's Miroslav Nosal. "But now that the exchange ratio is being announced, I believe it will help the shares in both companies," he said.
The news came too late to affect the share prices of Kaucuk and Chemoptrol on the Prague Stock Exchange on Wednesday. Chemopetrol closed up 12 crowns to 1,106 and Kaucuk rose 11 crowns to 1,105.
